source_commit_policy: A formal campaign must provide EXPECTED_COMMIT explicitly and use a clean 5090d worktree at that exact commit.
scientific_question: Can contact-focused refinement reduce the remaining absolute q discretization error without exceeding a 72-hour wall-clock envelope?

server_snapshot_2026_08_10.cpu: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X, 16 physical cores, 32 logical CPUs
server_snapshot_2026_08_10.note: This is a point-in-time capacity snapshot, not a reserved allocation. Every launch must repeat the checks.

contact_extent_basis.selection_shape: Cartesian central box in x-z; one transition layer is added by EREFINE
contact_extent_basis.vertical_extent: two 0.80-mm-thick bands centered on the eyelid-cornea path and the probe-eyelid path
contact_extent_basis.limitation: The box is a deterministic mesh-control region, not a measured circular contact boundary.

candidate_strategies.decision: mesh-only preflight, then one 2.00-mm 0/20-mmHg anchor pair if gates pass
mesh-only feasible, but nonlinear solve rejected under the recorded memory, disk, and 72-hour envelope; any future solve requires separate resources and authorization

exploratory_mesh_only_observation.reason: Measured during branch development before the source commit was frozen; it is used only to size the formal preflight.
exploratory_mesh_only_observation.condition: 2.00-mm geometry, 0.20-mm background, one local refinement pass, 1.80-mm half-width, two 0.80-mm-thick interface bands
exploratory_mesh_only_observation.interpretation: The layered local 0.10-mm target increases the node count by about 51% rather than causing the approximately sevenfold global 0.10-mm growth. A committed clean-worktree preflight is still mandatory.

extreme_mesh_only_observation.reason: Measured during branch development before the source commit was frozen; no nonlinear solve was started.
extreme_mesh_only_observation.condition: 2.00-mm geometry, 0.20-mm background, two explicit local refinement passes, 1.80-mm half-width, two 0.80-mm-thick interface bands
extreme_mesh_only_observation.decision: Do not launch L005 nonlinear endpoints on the current server snapshot. An anchor pair alone would consume about 126 GiB in projected RST before DB and scratch.

pass_gates: projected anchor pair fits memory, disk, and 36-hour stage cap

stages.launch_policy: pressure sequential, one MAPDL process at a time

stages.conditional: Only after P1 passes all QC, at least 36 campaign hours remain, projected completion is within 72 hours, and enough storage is explicitly reserved.
Mesh-only by default. A nonlinear solve requires a separate authorization after measured P0/P1 resource review.

acceptance.convergence_claim_rule: L010 versus global 0.20 mm is a strategy comparison, not sufficient by itself for mesh independence. A converged absolute anchor requires L005 versus L010 to change q by no more than 2% with all QC passing.
additional_diagnostics: total probe force at both pressures

data_policy.git: configuration, launch/evaluation scripts, CSV/JSON summaries, manifests, hashes, and lightweight figures
data_policy.external: DB, RST, complete solve.out, scratch diagnostics, and postprocessed fields remain under a new 5090d campaign root
data_policy.no_automatic_deletion: No accepted DB/RST is deleted to make room for later stages. P2 requires storage reservation or separate authorization.
data_policy.aborted_preflight: No partial endpoint from a timeout, resource stop, or mesh-only run enters numerical q comparison.
